Interface TypeConverter

All Known Subinterfaces:
BeanWrapper, ConfigurablePropertyAccessor
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractNestablePropertyAccessor, AbstractPropertyAccessor, BeanWrapperImpl, DataBinder, DirectFieldAccessor, ExtendedServletRequestDataBinder, ExtendedWebExchangeDataBinder, ServletRequestDataBinder, SimpleTypeConverter, TypeConverterSupport, WebDataBinder, WebExchangeDataBinder, WebRequestDataBinder
public interface TypeConverter
Interface that defines type conversion methods. Typically (but not necessarily) implemented in conjunction with the PropertyEditorRegistry interface.

注意：由于 TypeConverter 实现通常基于PropertyEditors，而后者并非线程安全，因此 TypeConverters 本身也不应被视为线程安全。

Since:
2.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

  • Method Details

    • convertIfNecessary

      <T> @Nullable T convertIfNecessary(@Nullable Object value, @Nullable Class<T> requiredType) throws TypeMismatchException
      Convert the value to the required type (if necessary from a String).

      从 String 到任何类型的转换通常使用 `PropertyEditor` 类的 `setAsText` 方法，或者在 `ConversionService` 中的 Spring Converter。

      Parameters:
      value - 要转换的值
      requiredType - 必须转换的目标类型（或为 null，例如在集合元素的情况下未知）
      Returns:
      新值，可能是类型转换的结果
      Throws:
      TypeMismatchException - 如果类型转换失败
      See Also:
      • PropertyEditor.setAsText(String)
      • PropertyEditor.getValue()
      • ConversionService
      • Converter
